corrections.new_basis: Clear pressed bit six reaches this zero-D0 return directly. With bit six set, down held toggles Seven Forces shooting mode first; only the no-down path tests WeaponStateCooldown and returns here when it is nonnegative.

corrections.old_basis: Missing pressed bit six or nonnegative WeaponStateCooldown reaches this branch, which clears D0 and returns.

corrections.old_basis: Shared by the final miss and by all three rising guards.
corrections.new_basis: The final right-outer tile miss and the three negative-velocity guards return here. Each guard tests $1C(a5) after a center or outer tile hit and skips lower-terrain handling while that word is negative.

corrections.new_basis: This entry tests $23E(a5), stores +$2C000 in $1F8(a5) when nonzero, or branches to the negative-velocity store when zero.

corrections.old_basis: The helper selects +$2C000 or -$2C000 horizontal velocity in field $1F8 from event field $23E.
corrections.new_basis: The zero-$23E branch from the fast auxiliary entry stores signed -$2C000 in $1F8(a5) and returns; this label is the negative store, not the selector.

corrections.new_basis: This entry clears $21(a5) bit six, arms timer four in $5C(a5), and tests $23E(a5) before storing +$12000 or branching to the negative store in $1F8(a5).

corrections.old_basis: The helper clears part flag six, arms timer four, and selects +$12000 or -$12000 horizontal velocity in field $1F8.
corrections.new_basis: The zero-$23E branch from the slow auxiliary entry stores signed -$12000 in $1F8(a5) and returns; the flag clear and timer write belong to the preceding entry.

corrections.old_basis: The clamped and accelerated cases share this store.
corrections.new_basis: This store writes unchanged D0 when the incoming horizontal velocity is strictly below -$2A000; otherwise the preceding path subtracts $A800. It does not clamp D0 to the threshold.

corrections.old_basis: The clamped and accelerated cases share this store.
corrections.new_basis: This store writes unchanged D0 when the incoming horizontal velocity is at least +$2A000; otherwise the preceding path adds $A800. It does not clamp D0 to the threshold.

corrections.old_basis: The mirror of the left inner dispatch.
corrections.new_basis: The lower-right inner path indexes Physics_LowerRightInnerResponseTable with normalized D2, adds the Physics_HandleLowerLeftOuterTerrain base to the selected offset, then jumps through A4. Its preceding gates can set bits zero and two in 6(a5).

corrections.old_basis: The mirror of the left inner dispatch.
corrections.new_basis: The upper-right inner path indexes Physics_UpperRightInnerResponseTable with normalized D2, adds the Physics_HandleUpperLeftOuterTerrain base to the selected offset, then jumps through A4. Its preceding gate can set bit one in 6(a5).

corrections.old_basis: The routine initializes type $480 and copies display, position, mapping, phase, lifetime, and packed size fields from the source object.
corrections.new_basis: This entry writes type $480 to (a0), copies selected display and sprite fields plus X/Y from a1, writes parameters D3/D4 to $48/$4A, and chooses separate word or packed longword copies of source fields 8..$B according to destination flag bit six.

corrections.old_basis: The routine initializes type $480 and copies display, position, mapping, phase, lifetime, and packed size fields from the source object.
corrections.new_basis: The destination-flag-bit-six branch copies one longword from 8(a1) to 8(a0) and returns. Type $480 and the other destination fields are written before this branch label.

corrections.new_basis: When RasterEffectInitState is zero, this entry advances it by four, installs HBlank_WriteSplitVScroll2AndStop_InstallList through LoadObjData, and enables the H-interrupt bit before falling into Update. Later calls branch directly to Update.

corrections.old_basis: The spin loop retries the Z80 bus request until the bus is granted.

corrections.new_basis: Reset already wrote the bus-request value through A1 before this label. This loop tests bit zero at (A1) and repeats while it remains set; it does not issue another request.

corrections.old_basis: When the copied size byte exceeds the controller threshold, this path clears bit 15 of the display-attribute word.
corrections.new_basis: The radial object's own $20(a5) byte is compared unsigned with PrimaryEntityAngle. When it is higher, this branch clears bit 15 of sprite attribute $E(a5); no size-byte comparison occurs here.

corrections.old_basis: When the copied size byte exceeds the controller threshold, this path clears bit 15 of the display-attribute word.
corrections.new_basis: The linked animation object first copies $20(a1) to $20(a5), compares that byte unsigned with PrimaryEntityAngle, and reaches this bit-15 clear of $E(a5) when the copied angle is higher.
